description: Helper functions for processing delivery payloads and generating outcomes in a cron/agent context, including summarization, payload selection, and error handling.

methods.name: pickSummaryFromOutput
methods.description: Generates a summary string from output text, truncated to 2000 characters if necessary.

methods.name: pickSummaryFromPayloads
methods.description: Selects a summary from a list of payloads, prioritizing non-error payloads.

methods.name: pickLastNonEmptyTextFromPayloads
methods.description: Retrieves the last non-empty text from payloads, ignoring errors.

methods.name: isDeliverablePayload
methods.description: Determines if a payload is suitable for delivery based on content and reply criteria.

methods.name: pickLastDeliverablePayload
methods.description: Finds the last payload in a list that is deliverable.

methods.name: pickDeliverablePayloads
methods.description: Filters payloads to return only successful, deliverable ones.

methods.name: isHeartbeatOnlyResponse
methods.description: Checks if the response is only a heartbeat acknowledgment without media.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatAckMaxChars
methods.description: Resolves the maximum characters for heartbeat acknowledgment based on agent config.

methods.name: resolveCronPayloadOutcome
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive outcome object from payloads, including summaries, errors, and structured content info.
